# NEW 2026-11-18 territory rework (INNER). Generated by gen_territory_inner.py; edit the generator, not this file.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_ti_theme_border_cache_pulse oe_ti_byz_pulse } }
# Theme scope: updates cached border-foreign flag at depth 2 (init + semi-annual Jan/Jul) so BYZ pulse avoids O(N^3).
oe_ti_theme_border_cache_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 1200
        is_rebel_country = no
        is_subject = yes
        country_type = building
        OR = { current_month = 1 current_month = 7 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_border_checked } }
        oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_ti_borders_foreign = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ti_borders_foreign_cached value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_border_checked } oe_ts_core = yes NOT = { oe_ts_course_civil = yes } }
                oe_ti_make_frontier = yes
            }
        }
        else = {
            remove_variable = oe_ti_borders_foreign_cached
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ti_border_checked value = 1 }
    }
}
oe_ti_byz_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 1200
        tag = BYZ
        is_rebel_country = no
        oe_byz_core_active = yes
        exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
        OR = { current_month = 1 current_month = 4 current_month = 7 current_month = 10 }
    }
    effect = { oe_ti_byz_monthly = yes }
}
